english_text: Clear money. Clear evidence. Clear next steps.
amharic_translation: ግልጽ ገንዘብ። ግልጽ ማስረጃ። ግልጽ እርምጃ።
oromiffa_translation: Maallaqa ifa. Ragaa ifa. Tarkaanfii ifa.
tigrigna_translation: ንጹር ገንዘብ። ንጹር መርትዖ። ንጹር ስጉምቲ።

english_text: Every payment follows four transparent steps — guaranteed protection for clients and freelancers.
amharic_translation: እያንዳንዱ ክፍያ አራት ግልጽ ደረጃዎችን ይከተላል — ለደንበኞችም ሆነ ለፍሪላንሰሮች የተረጋገጠ ጥበቃ።
oromiffa_translation: Kaffaltiin hundi tarkaanfilee ifa ta'an afur hordofa — maamilaafi hojjettoota bilisaatiif eegumsa guutuu.
tigrigna_translation: ነፍሲ ወከፍ ክፍሊት ኣርባዕተ ግሉጻት ደረጃታት ይስዕብ — ንዓማዊልን ንሰራሕተኛታትን ውሑስ ሓለዋ።

english_text: Every step is recorded and time-stamped so both sides have complete peace of mind.
amharic_translation: ሁለቱም ወገኖች ሙሉ እረፍት እንዲኖራቸው እያንዳንዱ እርምጃ በጊዜ ማህተም ይመዘገባል።
oromiffa_translation: Gareewwan lamaanuu yaaddoo tokko malee akka hojjetaniif tarkaanfiin hundi sa'aatiin galmaa'a.
tigrigna_translation: ክልቲኦም ወገናት ምሉእ ቅሳነት ክህልዎም ነፍሲ ወከፍ ስጉምቲ ብሰዓት ይምዝገብ።

english_text: You deposit the agreed amount into escrow before work starts. It is held safely and never sent until you approve.
amharic_translation: ሥራ ከመጀመሩ በፊት የተስማሙበትን የገንዘብ መጠን በኤስክሮው ያስቀምጣሉ። እርስዎ እስካላጸደቁ ድረስ በደህንነት ተይዞ ይቆያል።
oromiffa_translation: Hojiin jalqabamuu dura maallaqa waliigaltanii qabsiisa amansiisaa (escrow) keessa keessu. Hanga isin mirkaneessitanitti nageenyaan eegama.
tigrigna_translation: ስራሕ ቅድሚ ምጅማሩ ነቲ ዝተሰማማዕኩምሉ መጠን ገንዘብ ኣብ ኤስክሮው ተቐምጥዎ። ንስኹም ክሳብ ዘየጽደቕኩምዎ ብውሑስ ይዕቀብ።

english_text: The freelancer completes the milestone and submits deliverables, files and notes for your review.
amharic_translation: ፍሪላንሰሩ የሥራ ምዕራፉን አጠናቆ የተዘጋጁ ፋይሎችን፣ ሰነዶችንና ማስታወሻዎችን ለግምገማ ያቀርባል።
oromiffa_translation: Hojjetaan bilisaa marsaa hojichaa xumuree bu'aa hojii, faayilootaa fi ibsa isaa gamaggamaaf dhiyeessa.
tigrigna_translation: እቲ ሰራሕተኛ ነቲ ብርኪ ዕዮ ኣወዲኡ ዝተሰርሑ ሰነዳትን መብርህን ንግምገማ የቕርብ።

english_text: Satisfied with the delivery? Approve it and funds release instantly into the freelancer's wallet.
amharic_translation: በቀረበው ሥራ ረክተዋል? አጽድቁት፤ ክፍያው ወዲያውኑ ወደ ፍሪላንሰሩ ዋሌት ይለቀቃል።
oromiffa_translation: Hojichatti quuftaniittuu? Mirkaneessaa, maallaqni yeruma sana boorsaa hojjetaatti gadi lakkifama.
tigrigna_translation: በቲ ዝተሰርሐ ስራሕ ዓጊብኩም ዲኹም? ኣጽድቕዎ፤ እቲ ገንዘብ ብኡንብኡ ናብ ቦርሳ እቲ ሰራሕተኛ ይልቀቕ።

english_text: Need revisions or hit a problem? Support mediates with clear evidence for a fair resolution.
amharic_translation: ማስተካከያ ይፈልጋሉ ወይስ ችግር ተፈጠረ? የእርቅ ቡድናችን ግልጽ ማስረጃዎችን መሠረት በማድረግ ፍትሃዊ መፍትሄ ይሰጣል።
oromiffa_translation: Sirreeffamni barbaachisaa moo rakkoon uumame? Gareen jaarsummaa ragaa qabatamaadhaan haqa qabeessummaan fura.
tigrigna_translation: ምዕራይ የድሊ ወይ ጸገም ኣጋጢምኩም? ናይ ሽምግልና ጋንታና ብግሉጽ መርትዖ ፍትሓዊ ፍታሕ ይህብ።

english_text: One small percentage. Only when work pays out.
amharic_translation: አነስተኛ መቶኛ። ሥራው ተጠናቆ ክፍያው ሲለቀቅ ብቻ።
oromiffa_translation: Dhibbeentaa xiqqoo tokko. Yeroo hojiin kaffaltii argatu qofa.
tigrigna_translation: ንእሽቶ ሚእታዊት። ስራሕ ተወዲኡ ክፍሊት ክልቀቕ ከሎ ጥራይ።

english_text: Nothing is charged upfront. Fees are split between client and freelancer at the moment escrow releases.
amharic_translation: ምንም አይነት ቅድመ ክፍያ አይኖርም። ኤስክሮው በሚለቀቅበት ቅጽበት ክፍያው በደንበኛውና በፍሪላንሰሩ መካከል ይጋራል።
oromiffa_translation: Dursa kaffaltiin homtuu hin jiru. Yeroo qabsiisni gadi lakkifamu kaffaltiin maamilaa fi hojjetaa gidduutti qoodama.
tigrigna_translation: ቅድመ-ክፍሊት ፈጺሙ የለን። ኤስክሮው ኣብ ዝልቀቐሉ ግዜ እቲ ክፍሊት ኣብ መንጎ ዓሚልን ሰራሕተኛን ይምቀል።

english_text: Deposits and withdrawals via Telebirr or CBE — no hidden wire charges.
amharic_translation: ገንዘብ ማስገባትና ማውጣት በቴሌብር ወይም በኢትዮጵያ ንግድ ባንክ — ምንም የተደበቀ ክፍያ የለም።
oromiffa_translation: Galchuufi baasuun Telebirr yookiin Baankii Daldala Itoophiyaatiin — kaffaltiin dhokataan hin jiru.
tigrigna_translation: ምእታውን ምውጻእን ብቴሌብር ወይ ብንግዲ ባንኪ ኢትዮጵያ — ዝኾነ ሕቡእ ክፍሊት የለን።

english_text: Six launch categories covering Ethiopia's most in-demand digital skills.
amharic_translation: በኢትዮጵያ በብዛት የሚፈለጉ የዲጂታል ክህሎቶችን ያካተቱ ስድስት ዘርፎች።
oromiffa_translation: Dandeettiiwwan dijitaalaa Itoophiyaa keessatti barbaadaman jaha dhiyeessina.
tigrigna_translation: ኣብ ኢትዮጵያ ዝያዳ ዝድለዩ ናይ ዲጂታል ክእለታት ዘጠቓልሉ ሽዱሽተ ዓውድታት።

english_text: Post a role in minutes or join the talent pool — Ethiopia's digital workforce is one deck away.
amharic_translation: በደቂቃዎች ውስጥ ሥራ ይለጥፉ ወይም የባለሙያዎች ማህበረሰባችንን ይቀላቀሉ።
oromiffa_translation: Daqiiqaa muraasa keessatti hojii maxxansaa yookiin miseensa hojjettoota dijitaalaa Itoophiyaa ta'aa.
tigrigna_translation: ኣብ ውሽጢ ደቓይቕ ስራሕ ለጥፉ ወይ ድማ ናብ ማሕበረሰብ ሰብሞያ ተጸንበሩ።

english_text: I funded escrow on a Friday and the first milestone was approved by Tuesday. No chasing, no awkward money conversations.
amharic_translation: አርብ ዕለት በኤስክሮው ገንዘብ አስገባሁ፤ የመጀመሪያው ምዕራፍ ማክሰኞ ጸደቀ። ምንም አይነት ማሳደድ ወይም ስለ ገንዘብ መጨነቅ አልነበረም።
oromiffa_translation: Jimaata maallaqa qabsiisa (escrow) keessa kaa'e, marsaan jalqabaa Kibxata mirkanaa'e. Hordoffiin hin jiru, maallaqaaf wal-dhabdeen hin jiru.
tigrigna_translation: ዓርቢ ኣብ ኤስክሮው ገንዘብ ኣቐሚጠ፤ እቲ ቀዳማይ ብርኪ ስራሕ ሰሉስ ጸዲቑ። ዝኾነ ምድላይ ወይ ዘይምቹእ ናይ ገንዘብ ዕላል ኣይነበረን።

english_text: As a freelancer in Bahir Dar, getting paid used to be the hardest part. Now funds land in my wallet the moment the client approves.
amharic_translation: በባህር ዳር እንደምኖር ፍሪላንሰር ክፍያ ማግኘት ከባዱ ነገር ነበር። አሁን ግን ደንበኛው እንዳጸደቀ ገንዘቡ ወዲያውኑ ዋሌቴ ውስጥ ይገባል።
oromiffa_translation: Akka hojjetaa bilisaa Baahir Daar keessa jiraatuutti kaffaltii argachuun baay'ee ulfaataa ture. Amma garuu akkuma maamilri mirkaneesseen maallaqni yeruma sana boorsaa kootti gala.
tigrigna_translation: ኣብ ባህርዳር ከምዝነብር ናጻ ሰራሕተኛ ክፍሊት ምርካብ እቲ ዝኸበደ ክፍሊ እዩ ነይሩ። ሕጂ ግን ዓሚል ምስተቐበሎ ብኡንብኡ እቲ ገንዘብ ናብ ቦርሳይ ይኣቱ።

english_text: We had one disagreement about scope. Support reviewed the brief and messages and settled it in two days — fairly.
amharic_translation: በሥራው ወሰን ላይ አንድ አለመግባባት ገጥሞን ነበር። የድጋፍ ሰጪው ቡድን መመሪያውንና መልዕክቶቹን ገምግሞ በሁለት ቀናት ውስጥ በፍትሃዊነት ፈታው።
oromiffa_translation: Bal'ina hojii irratti wal-dhabdee tokko qabna turre. Gareen deeggarsaa qajeelfamaa fi ergaawwan ilaalee guyyoota lama keessatti haqa qabeessummaan fure.
tigrigna_translation: ኣብ ናይቲ ስራሕ ደረጃ ሓደ ዘይምርድዳእ ነይሩና። ናይ ደገፍ ጋንታ ነቲ መምርሕን መልእኽትታትን መርሚሩ ኣብ ክልተ መዓልታት ብፍትሓዊ መንገዲ ፈቲሕዎ።

english_text: Yekis connects Ethiopian businesses with verified freelance talent — and keeps every payment locked in escrow until the work is delivered and approved. No chasing invoices, no awkward money conversations. Just clear rules both sides can trust.
amharic_translation: ዬኪስ የኢትዮጵያ ንግዶችን ከተረጋገጡ የፍሪላንስ ባለሙያዎች ጋር ያገናኛል — ሥራው ተጠናቆ እስኪጸድቅ ድረስ እያንዳንዱን ክፍያ በኤስክሮው ይጠብቃል። ደረሰኝ ማሳደድ የለም፣ ስለ ገንዘብ መጨነቅ የለም። ሁለቱም ወገኖች የሚተማመኑባቸው ግልጽ ደንቦች ብቻ።
oromiffa_translation: Yekis daldaloota Itoophiyaa ogeessota bilisaa mirkanaa'an waliin walqunnamsiisa — hamma hojiin dhiyaatee mirkanaa'utti kaffaltii hunda qabsiisa amansiisaa (escrow) keessatti eega. Nagahee hordofuun hin jiru, maallaqaaf cinqamuun hin jiru. Seerota ifa ta'an gama lamaanuu itti amanan qofa.
tigrigna_translation: ዬኪስ ንንግዲ ትካላት ኢትዮጵያ ምስ ዝተረጋገጹ ናይ ፍሪላንስ ሰብሞያ የራኽብ — እቲ ስራሕ ቀሪቡ ክሳብ ዝጸድቕ ድማ ንነፍሲ ወከፍ ክፍሊት ኣብ ኤስክሮው ውሑስ ገይሩ ይዕቅቦ። ደረሰኝ ምድላይ የለን፣ ብዛዕባ ገንዘብ ጭንቀት የለን። ክልቲኦም ወገናት ዝተኣማመኑሎም ግሉጻት ሕግታት ጥራይ።

english_text: Freelancers verify with the Ethiopian National ID (Fayda), so you always know exactly who you are hiring.
amharic_translation: ፍሪላንሰሮች በኢትዮጵያ ብሔራዊ መታወቂያ (ፋይዳ) የተረጋገጡ ናቸው፤ ስለዚህ ማንን እንደሚቀጥሩ በትክክል ያውቃሉ።
oromiffa_translation: Hojjettoonni bilisaa Waraqaa Eenyummaa Biyyooleessaa (Fayidaa) tiin kan mirkanaa'aniidha, kanaaf eenyuun akka qacartan beektu.
tigrigna_translation: ናጻ ሰራሕተኛታት ብናይ ኢትዮጵያ ሃገራዊ መንነት (ፋይዳ) ዝተረጋገጹ እዮም፤ ስለዚ ንመን ከም ትቖጽሩ ብልክዕ ትፈልጡ።

english_text: Funds stay locked in escrow and only release when you inspect and approve each delivered milestone.
amharic_translation: ገንዘብ በኤስክሮው ተቆልፎ የሚቆይ ሲሆን እያንዳንዱን የተጠናቀቀ የሥራ ምዕራፍ መርምረው ሲያጸድቁ ብቻ ይለቀቃል።
oromiffa_translation: Maallaqni qabsiisa keessatti hidhamee tura, kan gadi lakkifamus yeroo isin marsaa hojichaa qorattanii mirkaneessitan qofa.
tigrigna_translation: ገንዘብ ኣብ ኤስክሮው ተዓጽዩ ይጸንሕ፣ ዝልቀቕ ድማ ነፍሲ ወከፍ ዝቐረበ ብርኪ ዕዮ መርሚርኩም ምስ ኣጽደቕኩምዎ ጥራይ እዩ።

english_text: Straight answers about money verification and disputes.
amharic_translation: ስለ ገንዘብ ደህንነት፣ ማንነት ማረጋገጫና አለመግባባት አፈታት ቀጥተኛ መልሶች።
oromiffa_translation: Nageenya maallaqaa, mirkaneessa eenyummaa fi furmaata falmii ilaalchisee deebii kallattii.
tigrigna_translation: ብዛዕባ ውሕስነት ገንዘብ፣ ምርግጋጽ መንነትን ምፍታሕ ክርክርን ቀጥታዊ መልስታት።

english_text: No question matches that. Try "escrow", "withdraw" or "KYC".
amharic_translation: ከዚያ ጋር የሚዛመድ ጥያቄ የለም። "ኤስክሮው"፣ "ማውጣት" ወይም "ማንነት" ብለው ይሞክሩ።
oromiffa_translation: Gaaffiin sanaan walsimu hin jiru. "qabsiisa", "baasuu" yookiin "KYC" jedhaa yaalaa.
tigrigna_translation: ምስኡ ዝመሳሰል ሕቶ የለን። "ኤስክሮው"፣ "ምውጻእ" ወይ "KYC" ኢልኩም ፈትኑ።

english_text: Yes. When you fund a job, your payment goes into escrow — held separately from Yekis's own operating funds — not directly to the freelancer. It only releases when you approve the work, or automatically after 5 days if you don't respond. If something's wrong, raise it before approving and the payment stays held while we help sort it out.
amharic_translation: አዎ። ለስራ ገንዘብ ሲያስገቡ ክፍያዎ ወደ ኤስክሮው ይገባል — ከዬኪስ የስራ ማስኬጃ ገንዘብ ተለይቶ ይቀመጣል እንጂ በቀጥታ ለፍሪላንሰሩ አይሄድም። የሚለቀቀው እርስዎ ስራውን ሲያጸድቁ ወይም ምላሽ ካልሰጡ ከ5 ቀናት በኋላ በራስ-ሰር ነው። ችግር ካለ ከማጽደቅዎ በፊት ቅሬታ ያቅርቡ፤ እኛ እስክንፈታው ድረስ ክፍያው ተይዞ ይቆያል።
oromiffa_translation: Eeyyee. Yeroo hojiif maallaqa galchitan, kaffaltiin keessan qabsiisa amansiisaa (escrow) keessa gala — maallaqa sochii Yekis irraa addatti qabama malee kallattiin gara hojjetaatti hin darbu. Kan gadi lakkifamu yeroo isin hojicha mirkaneessitan, yookiin yoo deebii hin kennin guyyoota 5 booda ofumaan. Rakkoon yoo jiraate osoo hin mirkaneessin dura beeksisaa, hamma furmaata argatutti maallaqni qabamee tura.
tigrigna_translation: እወ። ንስራሕ ገንዘብ ክተእትዉ ከለኹም ክፍሊትኩም ናብ ኤስክሮው እዩ ዝኣቱ — ካብ ናይ ዬኪስ ናይ ስራሕ ማስኬጃ ተፈልዩ ይቕመጥ እምበር ብቐጥታ ናብቲ ሰራሕተኛ ኣይከይድን። ዝልቀቕ ንስኹም ነቲ ስራሕ ምስ ኣጽደቕኩምዎ ወይ መልሲ እንተዘይሂብኩም ድሕሪ 5 መዓልታት ብባዕሉ እዩ። ጸገም እንተሃልዩ ቅድሚ ምጽዳቕኩም ጥርዓን ኣቕርቡ፤ ንሕና ክሳብ ንፈትሖ እቲ ገንዘብ ተታሒዙ ይጸንሕ።

english_text: What if the freelancer disappears after I pay?
oromiffa_translation: Kaffaltii ergan raawwadhee booda hojjetaan yoo badehoo?
tigrigna_translation: ክፍሊት ምስ ፈጸምኩ እቲ ሰራሕተኛ ድምጹ እንተኣጥፊኡኸ?

english_text: Your money is still sitting safely in escrow — it was never sent to them. If a freelancer goes silent raise it with our team and we'll help resolve it which can include a full refund.
amharic_translation: ገንዘብዎ አሁንም በደህንነት በኤስክሮው ውስጥ ይገኛል — መጀመሪያውኑም ለነሱ አልተላከም። ፍሪላንሰሩ ምላሽ ካቆመ ለቡድናችን ያሳውቁ፤ ሙሉ ገንዘብ ተመላሽ ማድረግን ጨምሮ መፍትሄ እንሰጣለን።
oromiffa_translation: Maallaqni keessan ammayyuu qabsiisa amansiisaa (escrow) keessatti nageenyaan jira — duraanuu gara isaaniitti hin ergamne. Hojjetaan yoo deebii dhabe, garee keenya beeksisaa, guutummaatti deebisuu dabalatee furmaata itti kennina.
tigrigna_translation: ገንዘብኩም ሕጂ’ውን ብውሑስ ኣብ ኤስክሮው ኣሎ — ካብ መጀመርታኡ ናብኦም ኣይተላእከን። እቲ ሰራሕተኛ ድምጺ እንተኣጥፊኡ ንጋንታና ሓብሩ፤ ምሉእ ገንዘብ ምምላስ ሓዊሱ ፍታሕ ክንረኽበሉ ኢና።

english_text: What if we disagree about the work?
oromiffa_translation: Hojicha irratti yoo walii galuu baannehoo?

english_text: Most disagreements get sorted directly between you and the freelancer within a short window. If you can't agree, our team reviews both sides — the original brief, the delivered work and your messages — and decides: release, refund, or split fairly.
amharic_translation: አብዛኞቹ አለመግባባቶች በእርስዎና በፍሪላንሰሩ መካከል በአጭር ጊዜ ውስጥ በቀጥታ ይፈታሉ። መስማማት ካልቻላችሁ ቡድናችን የሁለቱንም ወገን — የመጀመሪያውን የሥራ መመሪያ፣ የቀረበውን ሥራና መልዕክቶችን — ገምግሞ ፍትሃዊ ውሳኔ ይሰጣል፡ ክፍያውን መልቀቅ፣ መመለስ፣ ወይም በፍትሃዊነት መካፈል።
oromiffa_translation: Waldhabdeen baay'een isin fi hojjetaa gidduutti yeroo gabaabaa keessatti kallattiin furama. Yoo walii galuu dadhabdan, gareen keenya gama lamaanuu — qajeelfama jalqabaa, hojii dhiyaatee fi ergaawwan — gamaaggamuun murtoo kenna: gadi lakkisuu, deebisuu, yookiin haqa qabeessummaan qooduu.
tigrigna_translation: መብዛሕትኡ ዘይምርድዳእ ኣብ መንጎኹምን ኣብ መንጎ እቲ ሰራሕተኛን ኣብ ሓጺር ግዜ ብቐጥታ ይፍታሕ። ክትሰማምዑ እንተዘይክኢልኩም ጋንታና ንኽልቲኡ ወገን — ነቲ ናይ መጀመርታ መምርሒ ስራሕ፣ ዝቐረበ ስራሕን መልእኽትታትን — መርሚሩ ውሳነ ይህብ፡ ክፍሊት ምልቃቕ፣ ምምላስ፣ ወይ ብፍትሓዊ መንገዲ ምምቃል ይኸውን።

english_text: Why do I need to verify my identity (KYC)?
oromiffa_translation: Eenyummaa koo (KYC) maaliif mirkaneessuun na barbaachise?

english_text: It protects everyone. Verification is how we confirm the person you hire, or the client you work for, is really who they claim to be. Basic verification is quick and unlocks browsing and posting.
amharic_translation: ሁሉንም ሰው ይጠብቃል። ማረጋገጫ የምትቀጥሩት ሰው ወይም የምትሰሩለት ደንበኛ በትክክል እውነተኛ ማንነቱን የምናረጋግጥበት መንገድ ነው። መሠረታዊ ማረጋገጫ ፈጣን ሲሆን ስራዎችን ማየትና መለጠፍ ያስችላል።
oromiffa_translation: Hundumaa eega. Eenyummaa mirkaneessuun nama qacartan yookiin maamila hojjettaniif eenyummaa isaanii kan ittiin mirkaneessinudha. Mirkaneessi bu'uuraa ariifataadha, hojii ilaaluu fi maxxansuuf banaadha.
tigrigna_translation: ንኹሉ ሰብ ይሕሉ እዩ። ምጽራይ መንነት እቲ ትቖጽርዎ ሰብ ወይ ትሰርሕሉ ዓሚል ብሓቂ መንነቱ ዝረጋገጸሉ መገዲ እዩ። መሰረታዊ ምጽራይ ቅልጡፍ ኮይኑ ስራሕቲ ንምርኣይን ንምልጣፍን የኽእል።

english_text: Yekis takes a small percentage of each completed job, split between client and freelancer — never charged upfront, only when a payment actually releases.
amharic_translation: ዬኪስ ከተጠናቀቀ እያንዳንዱ ሥራ አነስተኛ መቶኛ ብቻ ይወስዳል፣ ይህም በደንበኛውና በፍሪላንሰሩ መካከል ይካፈላል — ምንም አይነት ቅድመ ክፍያ አይጠየቅም፣ ክፍያው በትክክል ሲለቀቅ ብቻ ነው።
oromiffa_translation: Yekis hojii xumurame hunda irraa dhibbeentaa xiqqoo qofa fudhata, kunis maamilaa fi hojjetaa gidduutti qoodama — dursee hin kaffalamu, yeroo kaffaltiin gadi lakkifamu qofa.
tigrigna_translation: ዬኪስ ካብ ዝተወድአ ነፍሲ ወከፍ ስራሕ ንእሽቶ ሚእታዊት ጥራይ ይወስድ፣ እዚ ድማ ኣብ መንጎ ዓሚልን ሰራሕተኛን ይምቀል — ቅድመ ክፍሊት ፈጺሙ ኣይሕተትንም፣ ክፍሊት ብትኽክል ክልቀቕ ከሎ ጥራይ እዩ።

english_text: When do I actually get paid?
The moment a client approves your work (or after the 5-day auto-release window), funds move into your Yekis wallet immediately. From there you can withdraw to Telebirr or your bank account.
amharic_translation: ደንበኛው ሥራዎን እንዳጸደቀ (ወይም ከ5 ቀናት የራስ-ሰር መልቀቂያ ጊዜ በኋላ) ገንዘቡ ወዲያውኑ ወደ ዬኪስ ዋሌትዎ ይተላለፋል። ከዚያም ወደ ቴሌብር ወይም የባንክ ሂሳብዎ ማውጣት ይችላሉ።
oromiffa_translation: Akkuma maamilri hojii keessan mirkaneesseen (yookiin guyyoota 5 ofiin gadi lakkifamu booda), maallaqni yeruma sana boorsaa Yekis keessanitti darba. Achirraa gara Telebirr yookiin herrega baankii keessaniitti baafachuu dandeessu.
tigrigna_translation: ዓሚል ስራሕኩም ምስተቐበሎን ምስ ኣጽደቖን (ወይ ድሕሪ 5 መዓልታት ብባዕሉ ዝልቀቐሉ ግዜ) እቲ ገንዘብ ብኡንብኡ ናብ ናይ ዬኪስ ቦርሳኹም ይኣቱ። ካብኡ ናብ ቴሌብር ወይ ናብ ናይ ባንኪ ሕሳብኩም ከተውጽእዎ ትኽእሉ።

english_text: Is there a minimum withdrawal amount?
oromiffa_translation: Hangi maallaqa baasuuf murtaa'e xiqqaan jiraa?
tigrigna_translation: ዝተወሰነ ዝተሓተ ናይ ምውጻእ መጠን ኣሎ ድዩ?

english_text: A small minimum applies per withdrawal to keep payment-rail costs sensible. The exact figure is shown in your wallet before you confirm.
amharic_translation: የክፍያ መስመር ወጪዎችን ምክንያታዊ ለማድረግ በእያንዳንዱ ማውጣት ላይ አነስተኛ ገደብ አለ። ትክክለኛው መጠን ከማረጋገጥዎ በፊት በዋሌትዎ ውስጥ ይታያል።
oromiffa_translation: Baasii sarara kaffaltii qusachuuf kaffaltii baafachuu tokkoon tokkoon irratti hangi xiqqaan ni jiraata. Hangi sirrii ta'e osoo hin mirkaneessin dura boorsaa keessan keessatti mul'ata.

english_text: Your money is still sitting safely in escrow — it was never sent to them in the first place. If a freelancer goes silent raise it with our team and we'll help resolve it which can include a full refund.

oromiffa_translation: Hojicha irratti yoo walii galuu baannehoo?

english_text: Most disagreements get sorted out directly between you and the freelancer, with a short window to talk it through. If you can't agree, our team reviews both sides — the original brief, the delivered work, and your messages — and makes a call: release the payment, refund it, or split it fairly. If either side still disagrees with that decision, there's a final formal step through an independent arbitration body — but the vast majority of cases never need to go that far.

english_text: Why do I need to verify my identity (KYC)?
oromiffa_translation: Eenyummaa koo (KYC) maaliif mirkaneessuun na barbaachise?

english_text: It protects everyone on the platform — it's how we make sure the person you're hiring, or the client you're working for, is really who they say they are. Basic verification is quick (a valid ID and a few details) and unlocks browsing and posting jobs. A slightly deeper verification step is required before withdrawing earnings, which protects freelancers' payouts from fraud.

tigrigna_translation: ዬኪስ ካብ ዝተወድአ ነፍሲ ወከፍ ስራሕ ንእሽቶ ሚእታዊት ጥራይ ይወስድ፣ እዚ ድማ ኣብ መንጎ ዓሚልን ሰራሕተኛን ይምቀል — ቅድመ ክፍሊት ፈጺሙ ኣይሕተትንም፣ ክፍሊት ብትኽክል ክልቀቕ ከሎ ጥራይ እዩ።

english_text: When do I actually get paid?
The moment a client approves your work (or after the 5-day auto-release window), funds move into your Yekis wallet immediately. From there you can withdraw to your Telebirr or bank account.
amharic_translation: ደንበኛው ሥራዎን እንዳጸደቀ (ወይም ከ5 ቀናት የራስ-ሰር መልቀቂያ ጊዜ በኋላ) ገንዘቡ ወዲያውኑ ወደ ዬኪስ ዋሌትዎ ይተላለፋል። ከዚያም ወደ ቴሌብር ወይም የባንክ ሂሳብዎ ማውጣት ይችላሉ።

tigrigna_translation: ዓሚል ስራሕኩም ምስተቐበሎን ምስ ኣጽደቖን (ወይ ድሕሪ 5 መዓልታት ብባዕሉ ዝልቀቐሉ ግዜ) እቲ ገንዘብ ብኡንብኡ ናብ ናይ ዬኪስ ቦርሳኹም ይኣቱ። ካብኡ ናብ ቴሌብር ወይ ናብ ናይ ባንኪ ሕሳብኩም ከተውጽእዎ ትኽእሉ።

english_text: Yekis exists to give Ethiopian freelancers and their clients a workspace where good work can happen without needing informal trust or a lawyer.
amharic_translation: ዬኪስ የተፈጠረው ለኢትዮጵያ ፍሪላንሰሮችና ደንበኞቻቸው ያለ ያልተረጋገጠ መተማመን ወይም ጠበቃ ጥሩ ሥራ የሚከናወንበትን የሥራ ቦታ ለመስጠት ነው።
oromiffa_translation: Yekis kan uumame hojjettoota bilisaa Itoophiyaa fi maamiltoota isaaniitiif bakka hojii amantummaa al-idilee yookiin abukaatoo malee hojiin gaariin itti hojjetamu kennuufi.
tigrigna_translation: ዬኪስ ዝተመስረተ ንኢትዮጵያውያን ናጻ ሰራሕተኛታትን ዓማዊሎምን ብዘይ ዘይውሑስ ምትእምማን ወይ ጠበቓ ጽቡቕ ስራሕ ዝፍጸመሉ ናይ ስራሕ ቦታ ንምሃብ እዩ።

english_text: The trust gap in Ethiopian freelance work holds back incredible talent. Clients fear paying upfront and receiving nothing. Freelancers fear delivering work and never getting paid. Yekis bridges this gap with milestone-based escrow, protecting both sides.
amharic_translation: በኢትዮጵያ የፍሪላንስ ሥራ ውስጥ ያለው የእምነት ክፍተት ምርጥ ችሎታ ያላቸውን ባለሙያዎች ወደ ኋላ አስቀርቷል። ደንበኞች ገንዘብ አስቀድመው ከፍለው ምንም ላያገኙ እንደሚችሉ ይሰጋሉ። ፍሪላንሰሮች ደግሞ ሰርተው ክፍያ ላያገኙ እንደሚችሉ ይፈራሉ። ዬኪስ በኤስክሮው አማካኝነት የሁለቱንም ወገን ደህንነት ይጠብቃል።
oromiffa_translation: Hojii bilisaa Itoophiyaa keessatti hanqinni amantaa dandeettii ajaa'ibaa duubatti hambiseera. Maamiltoonni dursanii kaffalanii homaa dhabuu sodaatu. Hojjettoonni hojjetanii kaffaltii dhabuu sodaatu. Yekis qabsiisa amansiisaa (escrow) tiin qaamolee lamaanuu eega.
tigrigna_translation: ኣብ ኢትዮጵያ ዘሎ ናይ ምትእምማን ክፍተት ንንፉዓት ሰብሞያ ንድሕሪት ሒዝዎም ጸኒሑ እዩ። ዓማዊል ኣቐዲሞም ከፊሎም ዋላ ሓደ ከይረኽቡ ይፈርሁ። ሰራሕተኛታት ሰሪሖም ክፍሊት ከይስእኑ ይሰግኡ። ዬኪስ ብኤስክሮው ኣቢሉ ንክልቲኡ ወገን ውሑስ ይገብር።
ናይ ሓቂ ፕሮጀክትታት። ናይ ሓቂ ውጽኢታት።
